description: Companion code for the manuscript 'Topological Chromatin Information Theory' (PLOS Computational Biology, PCOMPBIOL-D-26-01280). Contains (1) the calibrated-simulation pipeline: a synthetic Hi-C contact-map generator with planted TAD domains, persistent-homology feature computation (persistence entropy in homology dimensions 0-2), maximum-entropy model implementation, regression recovery analysis, and sensitivity analysis, with all seeds and generative parameters fixed in config/generative_parameters.json; and (2) the real-data analysis of manuscript Section 2.10 (realdata/): per-gene TCIT features from Rao et al. Hi-C (GSE63525) in GM12878 and K562 at 10 kb resolution predicting ENCODE RNA-seq expression under whole-chromosome holdout, including the deposited per-gene feature tables (19,449 and 18,691 genes) and measured results.
title: TCIT: Topological Chromatin Information Theory — simulation pipeline and real-data analysis
